title: Fugic
description: Fugic fuses ancient magic and advanced technology into a single hybrid energy system — master Fugic Energy to cast programmable spells, power machines, command robot golems, and evolve through 100 levels across 10 tiers of power.
body:
# ⚙️ Fugic — Where Magic Meets Technology

Fugic is a Minecraft mod built around a single revolutionary concept: Fugic Energy (FE) — a hybrid power source born from the fusion of ancient magic and cutting-edge technology. Nothing in this mod works without it. Everything revolves around it.

## ⚡ What is Fugic Energy?

Fugic Energy is not mana. It's not RF. It's something entirely new — a living, unstable force that flows between the arcane and the mechanical. Kill enemies to gain Fugic XP, level up, and unlock greater energy capacity, stronger stats, and new spells. Master it, and you become unstoppable. Abuse it, and it will consume you.

### 🧬 Progression System — 100 Levels, 10 Tiers

Your journey through Fugic is measured in 100 levels divided into 10 Tiers, each unlocking greater energy capacity and new possibilities. Kill hostile mobs to gain Fugic XP and level up. Every 10 levels you advance a Tier, unlocking new spells, equipment and capabilities.

Tier 1 — Aprendiz Fugic — 100 FE 

Tier 2 — Iniciado Fugic — 250 FE 

Tier 3 — Invocador Fugic — 450 FE 

Tier 4 — Maestro Fugic — 700 FE 

Tier 5 — Arcano Fugic — 1.000 FE 

Tier 6 — Sintetizador Fugic — 1.500 FE 

Tier 7 — Nexus Fugic — 2.200 FE 

Tier 8 — Convergente Fugic — 3.200 FE 

Tier 9 — Transcendente Fugic — 5.000 FE 

Tier 10 — Origen Fugic — 10.000 FE 

Every level you gain permanent stat bonuses: +0.3 HP, +0.2% resistance, +1% damage, +0.8% magic damage and +0.08 FE/s passive regeneration.

### 🎮 Fugic Interface

Press X to open the Fugic Interface — your personal dashboard showing all your current stats, XP progress toward the next level, your FE and regeneration rate, your spell hotbar and talisman slots (coming soon).

### 🔮 Spell System — Combo Casting

Equip the Tech Scroll in your hand and cast spells using click combinations — no keybinds required. Your 7-slot circular spell wheel is always visible on screen in the bottom left corner. Chain left and right clicks in specific sequences to unleash your spells.
Current spells:

Tier 1 — Fugic Bolt: LEFT + LEFT + RIGHT — a fast magic projectile with a custom 3D model, flies straight toward your crosshair with no gravity, 25 block range, base damage 8 scaling with magic level bonus. Costs 15 FE.

Tier 1 — Energy Shield: RIGHT + RIGHT + LEFT — summons two magic shields orbiting around you, each absorbing one hit regardless of damage. Custom 3D models with transparency. Costs 20 FE.
More spells unlock with each Tier you reach.

### 💎 Items

Fugic Crystal — use it to absorb between 5 and 25 FE with epic sound and particle effects. Hard to get but worth it.

Fugic Amethyst Cluster — a rare ore that generates underground. Mine it to get Fugic Crystals. Recognizable by its dark purple and golden color, different from regular amethyst.

Tech Scroll — equip this in your hand to enable combo casting. Without it, your click combinations won't activate spells.

Spell Scroll — right click to permanently learn a new spell. Each Tier unlocks new Spell Scrolls with more powerful abilities.

### ⚔️ Coming Soon

Spectech — the first custom mob, a ghostly entity born from Fugic Energy and the soul of a dead mage. It detects your energy level and scales its attacks to your Tier.

Talisman system — equip up to 2 talismans that grant passive bonuses like extra FE regeneration, reduced spell cost or bonus magic damage.

Fugic machines — hybrid technology powered by FE, from energy extractors to automated golem workers.

Custom dimension — a corrupted realm where Fugic Energy flows freely and the most powerful enemies await.

**🚀 Current Version — Alpha 1.2.0

This mod is in active early development. Expect big changes, new content and improvements in every update.

Requires GeckoLib. Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric.**
